title: Wrong Item Claims Delivery-Charge Refund: Entitlement and Console Action
content:
**Entitlement.** An approved Delivery Claims Wrong Item Claim whose parcel brought wrong items is owed a wrong-shipment delivery refund wherever the share it covers is above zero, booked as one shipping fee refund entry on the claim for the whole parcel.

**Principle.** A Wrong Item Claim refunds the delivery charge of its order only in the share the claim covers, even though its claim type does not otherwise refund the shipping fee with its merchandise.

Booking the entry does not by itself resolve the claim.

| Approved Wrong Item Claim | Wrong-shipment delivery refund owed |
|---|---|
| share of the delivery charge it covers above zero | yes — one shipping fee refund entry for the whole parcel |

Once booked, this delivery-charge refund stands on the claim as a compensation entry among the claim's compensation records, next to its merchandise refunds, dated the day it was booked, with no order line and no units. The claim's status is not changed by the booking.

## Console action: `book_wrong_shipment_delivery_refund_014b5564`

**Situation of use and capability.** Books the delivery-charge refund owed on a Wrong Item Claim as one compensation entry on that claim, for a parcel of an order that brought the wrong items where the approved claim owes back part or all of the delivery charge. One call adds a single shipping-fee-refund compensation entry, dated today, to the claim's ledger for the whole parcel (no order line, no units), carrying the amount given. The claim's status is not changed. The booked entry appears among the claim's compensation records next to its merchandise refunds.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `book_wrong_shipment_delivery_refund_014b5564`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the claim number of the Wrong Item Claim the refund is booked on, as returned by the delivery-claim lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the delivery-charge refund given on the claim, in USD | a positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places (to the nearest cent, on the final figure); stored exactly as passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `entry_id` (the reference of the new compensation entry), `claim_id` (the claim it was booked on), `compensation_type` (always `shipping_fee_refund`), `amount_usd` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `booked_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving this receipt means the refund entry now stands on the claim.
